maria_p (product): Heads-up — pricing/packaging rollout scheduled for next Wed. We need final alignment on metering -> billing events, quota enforcement behavior, and any contract constraints. Who's owning what and any blockers?

aj_k (eng): I can own the metering integration work. PR in flight: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/742. Need final schema from billing and contract constraints from legal. ETA EOD Tue for my changes if we lock schema today.

sam_b (billing): Billing needs two event flavors: `invoiceable_unit` and `quota_violation`. Sample payload proposal:
```
{
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "metric": "token",
  "units": 100,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-10T14:12:00Z",
  "quota_policy": "hard"  // hard | soft
}
```
Also: retention for raw events? Suggest 6 months for audits.

irene_l (legal): On contracts: enterprise customers negotiated hard caps and some grandfathered pricing/measurement. We need a per-customer flag surfaced to billing (e.g., `contract_flags`) and a list of grandfathered IDs before enforcing hard caps. Do not auto-enforce until legal confirms the list.

lee_s (sre): From SRE: quota enforcers will live in the gateway path. We expect per-customer lookup to be <5ms. Recommend cache TTL ~30s and a small warmup for top customers. Also we need rate-limit rules for burst scenarios — define expected bursts so we can tune token buckets.

aj_k (eng): Implementation plan: metering service emits to Kafka topic `billing_events.v2`, billing consumes. Quota-check will be a sync call: gateway -> quota-service -> cache -> billing fallback. Question for product/billing: do we want synchronous hard enforcement (return 403) or soft warnings (allow and charge later)?

maria_p (product): Enterprise customers require hard quotas for compliance/billing transparency. Default/free-tier can be soft-throttled. So policy must be per-customer.

sam_b (billing): Billing can support both. If quota check returns `blocked` we will not create invoiceable events. Add `quota_policy` to the schema (hard|soft). Also need `metric_type` to support both token-based and call-based contracts.

aj_k (eng): I'll add `quota_policy` and `metric_type` to the PR. @lee_s can you confirm cache config? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/742

lee_s (sre): Confirming TTL 30s is fine. Also proposing a circuit-breaker: if billing consumer lag > 5s, gateway should fallback to `allow-soft` for safety. I'll add to runbook.

metering-bot: Weekly backlog snapshot: 17 open metering tickets. Highest priority: schema v2 merge blocking billing. See: https://issues/redwood/MT-198

irene_l (legal): Legal will provide the grandfathered customer list and any contract-specific enforcement rules by EOD Tue. Marking this as a hard blocker for enforcement.

maria_p (product): Owners & action items:
- aj_k (eng): implement `quota_policy` + `metric_type` changes, update PR (due Tue EOD)
- sam_b (billing): finalize event schema + retention + mapping for call vs token metrics (due Tue)
- irene_l (legal): deliver grandfathered list and constraints (Tue EOD)
- lee_s (sre): add cache + circuit-breaker config, perf signoff (Wed AM)
I'll post a short checklist to the product board when legal list lands.

aj_k (eng): tagging reviewers @sam_b @lee_s @maria_p. Will post deploy playbook & a quick smoke test plan.

sam_b (billing): One more contract edge: some enterprises limit unitization to "calls" not tokens. We need metric multiplexing: billing should accept both `token` and `call` with mapping rules. I'll draft the mapping doc today.

maria_p (product): :thumbsup: Thanks. If you hit a blocker ping here. I'll escalate at Friday sync if not green.

aj_k (eng): Small local test snippet for folks who want to exercise the flow:
```
curl -X POST https://local.redwood/metering -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"customer_id":"cust_123","metric":"token","units":10,"quota_policy":"soft"}'
```

lee_s (sre): I'll add an SLO: quota-check latency target -> p95 < 10ms, and add dashboard tile.

maria_p (product): Closing the loop: I'll wait for legal list and then confirm rollout gating. Thanks team.
